results.snippet: Your app has the technical capacity to draw identifiable health information both from the consumer (e.g., name, weight, height, age, and steps taken) and the fitness tracker (e.g., consumer’s name, miles run, heart rate), even if some consumers choose to not connect the fitness tracker. Our business is in the “HIPAA business associate” category. Does the FTC’s Rule apply to us? If your business acts solely as a “HIPAA business associate” – that is, if you handle only the protected health information of HIPAA-covered entities – the FTC’s Rule doesn’t apply.
